_source: Written against build/copy-rules.json, NOT copied from content-design-kit.md §6 — those examples predate the linter and every one of them fails it, on the pointer emoji (banned outright) and on trailing questions (rejected by Instagram and TikTok). Voice: content-design-kit.md §2, register B. A caption never describes the card; the graphic already carries the scores, names, fixtures and times.
_settleDay: podium, playerOfRound, teamOfWeek and topPlayers were `needsHuman` until 2026-09-02, on the reasoning that a post naming a real person is taste. They are mechanical now because the naming was never needed: §2 rule 2 forbids the caption restating what the card carries, and the card already carries every name, club and score. A caption that adds the stake instead reproduces no person's name and no manager-typed team name — which is what made these 'taste' in the first place. The names still go on the CARD, verbatim, including a team name our own style guide would reject.
